caption: Honoré Daumier, A Day When You Do Not Pay—Twenty-Five-Degree Heat, from Le Public du Salon (1852)
alt: A lithograph of a packed crowd at the Paris Salon: men in top hats and women in bonnets are pressed together beneath the paintings on the gallery wall, red-faced and wide-eyed, while a small boy is dragged through the crush by the hand. Below, the caption: "Un jour où l’on ne paye pas.—Vingt-cinq degrés de chaleur."
bibliography: Daumier, Honoré. Un jour où l’on ne paye pas. Vingt-cinq degrés de chaleur (A Day When You Do Not Pay—Twenty-Five-Degree Heat), from Le Public du Salon. Published in Le Charivari, 17 May 1852, lithograph, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, 1980.1114.2.
title: A Day When You Do Not Pay—Twenty-Five-Degree Heat (Un jour où l’on ne paye pas. Vingt-cinq degrés de chaleur)
